_comment: Remote kill switches for OpenBat. See OpenBat/FeatureFlags.swift. Only `false` does anything: every flag is compiled ON in the app, and this file can only override a default to off. Setting a flag back to true (or removing it) returns the app to the state Apple reviewed. Edit this file on `main` — the branch FeatureFlagStore.remoteURL names — or nothing happens; the copy on a version branch is only source. Leave everything true while a build is in review; flip after approval and before release. `configMenu` locks the config menu itself: setting it false closes the menu, drops every local override it had set, and returns the iNaturalist posting-cap bypass to its compiled state.
